hints.title: Smallest Available ID Reuse
hints.text: Maintain an incremental counter for new identifiers and a pool of released identifiers from deleted videos.

hints.title: Video Record Storage
hints.text: Store video string content, views, likes, and dislikes in a lookup dictionary keyed by videoId.

hints.title: View Increment Substring
hints.text: Watching a video increments its view count and returns video[startMinute:min(len, endMinute + 1)].

hints.title: Video Platform Implementation

complexity.time: O(log V) for upload and remove, O(L) for watch substring, O(1) for like, dislike, getViews
variables: L: length of video content string
complexity.notes: Min-heap manages smallest available ID in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning linearly for the smallest unused ID takes O(V) per upload.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary stores metadata and video strings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate efficiently allocates smallest available ID using heap and handles missing video IDs.
